notes.title: Gamer Stop Simulator - Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Gamer Stop Fans![/b][/h1][p]After the demo, we carefully considered all your feedback and are continuing development work for the Prologue version. Here are the features we are working on and the highlights so far:[/p][h2][b]🛠️ Repair & Second-Hand System[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Fully Interactive Repair Flow:[/b] All steps from fault diagnosis to unscrewing and screwing, component replacement, and testing can now be completed in a single flow.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597021/9b0a2f25e22fc58e3200ccef445a9162162374cb.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spare Parts Tracking:[/b] You can instantly check your stock levels through the Tablet and quickly replenish items when needed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Second-Hand 2.0:[/b] The condition of items is now a complete surprise. Open the box, test the product, clean it, and then proceed to negotiation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597021/91862b27a81593ab9c20efc4d8088683da51440d.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced Bargaining System:[/b] With a slider, ±5/±10 shortcuts, an acceptance probability indicator, and a customer satisfaction bar, negotiations are now more dynamic and controlled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick Deal:[/b] Instantly negotiate on barcoded items to speed up the sales process.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🛒 Store Management[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Unified Shelf System:[/b] You can now display all products on a single type of shelf, making store organization more practical.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Store Rating & Reputation:[/b] A higher rating attracts more customers, while a lower rating will still bring in a few curious visitors.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bills & Loans:[/b] You can take out loans from Gamer Bank and easily manage your daily expenses through the Bills panel.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🌍 City & Online Sales[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New City Layout:[/b] A larger and more detailed city design is now available. In the Prologue, only limited areas will be open, while the full version will expand district by district.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online Order System:[/b] Accept orders via PC, pack products, and ship them to run your store online.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]🎯 Collection Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Retro Game Capsules:[/b] Collect four different levels of boxes from vending machines around the city and try your luck at finding rare foil or gold editions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Showcase Shelves:[/b] Display your collectible items to increase customer interest in your store.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]🔹 Other Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cleaning and Inspection Mini-Games:[/b] Short and fun mini-games now let you clean and inspect products as part of the experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clearer UI Hints and Audio Feedback:[/b] Interface hints and sound effects make in-game interactions more understandable and satisfying.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Share Your Thoughts with Us! 💬[/b][/h2][p]

tags.feature: Fully Interactive Repair Flow: All steps from fault diagnosis to unscrewing and screwing, component replacement, and testing can now be completed in a single flow.
Spare Parts Tracking: You can instantly check your stock levels through the Tablet and quickly replenish items when needed.
Second-Hand 2.0: The condition of items is now a complete surprise. Open the box, test the product, clean it, and then proceed to negotiation.
Advanced Bargaining System: With a slider, ±5/±10 shortcuts, an acceptance probability indicator, and a customer satisfaction bar, negotiations are now more dynamic and controlled.
Quick Deal: Instantly negotiate on barcoded items to speed up the sales process.
Unified Shelf System: You can now display all products on a single type of shelf, making store organization more practical.
Store Rating & Reputation: A higher rating attracts more customers, while a lower rating will still bring in a few curious visitors.
Bills & Loans: You can take out loans from Gamer Bank and easily manage your daily expenses through the Bills panel.
New City Layout: A larger and more detailed city design is now available. In the Prologue, only limited areas will be open, while the full version will expand district by district.
Online Order System: Accept orders via PC, pack products, and ship them to run your store online.
Retro Game Capsules: Collect four different levels of boxes from vending machines around the city and try your luck at finding rare foil or gold editions.
Showcase Shelves: Display your collectible items to increase customer interest in your store.
Cleaning and Inspection Mini-Games: Short and fun mini-games now let you clean and inspect products as part of the experience.
Clearer UI Hints and Audio Feedback: Interface hints and sound effects make in-game interactions more understandable and satisfying.

notes.title: HotFix v0.31# Gamer Stop Simulator 13.06.2025
notes.content:
[h1][b]Thank You! ❤️[/b][/h1]

A huge thank you to everyone who has played the Gamer Stop Simulator demo and added it to their wishlist! Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated every day. 🙏

We were aware of some issues from day one, and our team jumped into action right away to address them. We're working hard to improve the experience and make Gamer Stop Simulator the best it can be. 

Today, we’re releasing a hotfix update to improve your experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597021/f2f9f92848ed45087b23b8d9bb3583c4171b4559.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]HotFix Notes 🔥[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Second-hand AI behaviors fixed: Issues related to AI logic in the second-hand trade system have been resolved.

[*] Customer interaction bugs fixed: Fixed cases where customers could get stuck or become unresponsive during interactions.

[*] Save system improvements:

[*] Fixed issues where saved products, paint colors, second shelf data, and other items were not loading properly.

[*] Overall save reliability and consistency improved.

[*] Language issues resolved: Fixed localization and translation problems affecting multiple UI elements.

[*] Second-hand trade interactions fixed: Resolved problems where players couldn’t interact with AIs during second-hand purchases or sales.

[*] Cash register customer bugs fixed: Fixed interaction issues with customers at the checkout counter.

[/list]
